items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: my present happiness is due to my best friend, Professor Fred Weinstein

ctx.x: Right. Right, it's there to -- and my present happiness is due to my best friend, Professor Fred Weinstein, who's been a professor at Yale and Southern Connecticut State College, and now he's writing a screen play. So that's what he's devoting his time to. But he was the best -- not only was he the best man. He introduced me to my wife.
